formative_worksheets.title: The Tally and Bar Check
formative_worksheets.when_to_use: After Lesson 3, before Lesson 4. Quick mid-unit check (10 min).
formative_worksheets.purpose: Standalone formative check confirming 2-way tally and bar graph construction before mode.
formative_worksheets.student_learning_goal: I can tally and build a bar graph.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can tally and build a bar graph.
header.character_watermark: Detective Dot in the top-right corner with a clipboard. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

prompts.prompt: Read the 2-way table. Find the row total for MILK.
prompts.visual_layout: Pre-built 2-way table with tally marks and writing line for total.

image_placeholders.description: A pre-built 2-way tally table for a Grade 2 formative check. 2x2 with tally marks. Below: 'Milk row total: ___'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: FORM_Q1_TABLE at Prompt 1: instructions ask the child to find row total. Keywords name the visual elements.

prompts.answer_key: Sum of the milk row tallies.

prompts.prompt: Build a 3-bar graph from the tallies given.
prompts.visual_layout: Tally for 3 categories + blank bar graph grid.

image_placeholders.description: Tally + blank bar graph for a Grade 2 formative check, B&W line art. Top: tally with 3 categories (apples 4, bananas 3, grapes 2). Bottom: blank bar graph grid for the child to draw.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: FORM_Q2_BUILD at Prompt 2: instructions ask the child to build a bar graph. Keywords name the format.

prompts.answer_key: Bars: apples 4, bananas 3, grapes 2 with title and labels.

prompts.prompt: How are you feeling? Circle the face.

image_placeholders.description: Three round face icons for a Grade 2 formative check. Smile, neutral, frown.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: FORM_Q3_FACES at Prompt 3: keywords name the visual.

formative_worksheets.teacher_notes: Administer between Lesson 3 and Lesson 4. Print one per child.

reflection_sheet.title: My Detective's Reflection (G2)
reflection_sheet.student_learning_goal: I can think about what I learned this week.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can think about what I learned this week.
header.character_watermark: Detective Dot and Tally with a Junior Data Detective certificate in the top-right. References blueprint.recurring_characters.

prompts.prompt: How do you feel about being a G2 Data Detective? Circle one.

image_placeholders.description: Three rating ovals for a Grade 2 reflection.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: REF_STARS at Prompt 1: keywords name the rating and role.

prompts.prompt: Did you do these things? Circle YES or NO.

image_placeholders.description: A 4-row YES/NO table for a Grade 2 reflection.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: REF_YN_TABLE at Prompt 2: keywords name response options.

options: I sorted with Venn or Carroll.

image_placeholders.description: Bordered rectangle for Grade 2 reflection. Above: 'My favourite detective skill was...'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: REF_FAV_BOX at Prompt 3: keywords name the focus.

prompts.prompt: The trickiest part for me was...

image_placeholders.description: Bordered rectangle for Grade 2 reflection. Above: 'The trickiest part for me was...'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: REF_TRICKY_BOX at Prompt 4: keyword matches the prompt.

prompts.prompt: Next time, I want to try...

image_placeholders.description: Bordered rectangle for Grade 2 reflection. Above: 'Next time, I want to try...'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: REF_NEXT_BOX at Prompt 5: keywords name the focus.

reflection_sheet.teacher_notes: Hand out at the end of Lesson 5 alongside Junior Data Detective certificate.
